controllerType: M4L-5559F integrated control box for lockstitch flatseamer
type: Lockstitch flatseamer / coverstitch machine integrated controller (电脑一体机)
source: 1_20210319 ZB-5559FF电脑一体机操作手册中文版本.pdf (Chinese-only, 7 pages)
note: Chinese-only manual. The ZB-5559FF (model M4L-5559F) is a lockstitch flatseamer integrated controller with stepping motor for backstitch/front-backstitch functions. AC 220±20% V, 550W. Has 4 socket connections on rear: ① pedal & upgrade, ② electromagnet socket, ③ blower socket (-N series optional), ④ auxiliary electromagnet socket. Panel is LCD with 16 buttons. Some parameters marked '此参数5559F机型上不适用' (not applicable to 5559F model).

buttons.name: P (parameter entry)
buttons.function: Long press to enter user parameter mode; press again to save and exit

buttons.name: Reset (factory restore)
buttons.function: Long press to restore factory program

buttons.name: Needle gauge +/-
buttons.function: Short press +: needle gauge +0.1mm; Long press +: continuous increase. Short press -: needle gauge -0.1mm

buttons.name: Presser foot height +/-
buttons.function: Short press +: presser foot height +1mm; Short press -: presser foot height -1mm

buttons.name: Startup voice / voice on-off
buttons.function: Not error: short press toggles startup voice; long press toggles voice function. With error: short press reads error code solution via voice

buttons.name: Free sewing / trimming key
buttons.function: Short press: select free sewing mode. Long press: LCD trimmer icon lights = trim on; long press again = trim off

buttons.name: Front backstitch key
buttons.function: Short press cycles: front backstitch, double front backstitch, off. Selects A/B stitch count (1-15 stitches)

buttons.name: Rear backstitch key
buttons.function: Short press cycles: rear backstitch, double rear backstitch, off. Selects C/D stitch count (1-15 stitches)

buttons.name: Density key / upper-lower stop needle position
buttons.function: Short press: cycle density modes (rear, off, front, front+rear). Long press: set upper/lower stop position

buttons.name: Pattern sewing / presser foot key
buttons.function: Short press: switch pattern mode / pattern editing. Long press: toggle presser foot function

buttons.name: W-sewing / multi-segment sewing
buttons.function: Short press: W-sewing (continuous add) mode. Long press: multi-segment sewing mode

buttons.name: Thread clamp / trigger
buttons.function: Short press: thread clamp on/off. Long press: trigger function on/off (only in multi-segment mode)

buttons.name: Presser foot key
buttons.function: Short press: after sewing auto thread cut and lift presser foot on/off. Long press: auto lift presser foot at mid-stop on/off

buttons.name: + (speed up)
buttons.function: Main interface: +50 RPM per press; long press continuous. In param mode: increment value

buttons.name: - (speed down)
buttons.function: Main interface: -50 RPM per press; long press continuous. In param mode: decrement value

buttons.name: Left select key
buttons.function: In param mode: navigate left through parameter range

buttons.name: Right select key
buttons.function: In param mode: navigate right through parameter range

parameterEntry.userParams: Power on standby → long press P key → enter parameter mode. Left/right keys move cursor; +/- keys modify value. Press P to flash and save parameter. Press P again to exit.
parameterEntry.needleStopPosition: Standby → press P then trim key → enter monitoring mode (shows 024 parameter). Turn handwheel to upper needle stop position; displayed value tracks handwheel. Press P when center is at 024 to set 0, simultaneously calculates lower stop position.
parameterEntry.saveParams: In monitoring interface: long press right key to save current parameter. Standby: long press reset key to restore saved params.
parameterEntry.versionQuery: Standby → press P then trim key → enter version display. Press +/- to switch program versions (h=panel software A=main controller V=version code).
parameterEntry.counterStitchCount: Standby → press P then + key → enter counter/stitch count interface. Left/right keys switch counter and stitch count.
parameterEntry.stepperZeroCalibration: Standby → enter user param mode → navigate to P81. Use A4 paper, run at 4000rpm, adjust param until needle hits 10 stitches, press P to save. Note: P81 auto-sets stitch gauge to 0 when in P81 interface; restores on exit.
parameterEntry.needleGaugeAdjust: Set stitch gauge to 5mm → adjust to P82 (forward stitch gauge compensation). Use A4 paper, run at 200rpm. Adjust until needle count is 11 stitches (forward). Save with P. Enter P83 (reverse stitch gauge compensation). Run forward, engage reverse switch. Adjust until 11 stitches match. Save. Note: P82/P83 auto-set speed to 200rpm while in interface.

alarmCodes.description: Stitch count alarm — count has reached the set upper limit
alarmCodes.solution: Press P to cancel alarm and restart count

alarmCodes.description: Trim count alarm — trim count has reached the set upper limit
alarmCodes.solution: Press P to cancel alarm and restart count

alarmCodes.description: New machine prompt — new machine startup reminder
Overturning table alarm — machine head is overturned
alarmCodes.solution: Correct machine head, ensure table flip switch is restored

errorCodes.solution: 1. Turn off system, reconnect power after 30s. 2. Enter P62 to check main motor initial angle. 3. Check main motor encoder and speed governor for damage. 4. Contact local service if unresolved.
Turn off controller. Check AC input; if below 176V restore to normal then restart. Contact service if still abnormal.
Turn off controller. Check AC input; if above 264V restore to normal then restart.
Same as Err-04.
1. Check electromagnet connection — is it loose, falling off, broken, or abnormal. 2. Turn off; check if each electromagnet voltage is normal. 3. Contact service if unresolved.
Turn off system; reconnect after 30s and observe if normal. Try again — if fault is frequent, contact local service.

1. Check for abnormal winding on machine. Check if machine roller has thread stuck. Check if machine cam is stuck. 2. Turn off controller; check main motor power input is not loose or broken. 3. Enter P62 to check main motor initial angle. 4. Contact service if unresolved.

1. Check if operation panel and electronic control wiring is loose, loose, or broken. 2. Check if panel controller and speed governor connection is loose or speed governor is damaged. 3. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.description: Machine head needle position signal fault
errorCodes.solution: 1. Check if main motor encoder and controller connection is loose. 2. Replace main motor encoder. 3. Contact service if unresolved.

errorCodes.description: Main motor initial angle detection fault
errorCodes.solution: Power off and restart 2-3 times; if still faulting contact service.
1. Turn off system; check if main motor encoder connector is loose or fallen off; restore normal then restart. 2. Replace main motor encoder.
Turn off system; reconnect after 30s; if controller still abnormal contact service.
1. Check main motor initial angle. 2. Contact service if unresolved.
Same as Err-15.
Turn off system; reconnect after 30s; if controller still abnormal contact service.
Check if main motor is stuck; restart if not stuck; contact service.
Check if machine oil is sufficient; contact service if still present after refilling.
1. Check for abnormal winding. Check roller/cam for stuck thread. Check cam. 2. Turn off; check main motor power input. 3. Enter P62. 4. Contact service.
Check if bottom thread is sufficient; if error persists after sufficient thread contact service.
Clean lint on machine; if still abnormal contact service.
Machine has reached service time; continue using and contact service.

errorCodes.description: Reverse sewing stepper motor zero position fault
errorCodes.solution: 1. Check if stepper motor, transmission, gears are stuck. Restore normal then restart. 2. Check if reverse sewing stepper encoder is normal; replace if damaged. 3. Contact service.

errorCodes.description: Reverse sewing stepper motor hardware overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: 1. Turn off; reconnect after 30s. 2. Check stepper motor, transmission, gears for stuck. Restore normal then restart. 3. Contact service.

errorCodes.description: Reverse sewing stepper motor current A detection circuit fault
errorCodes.solution: Turn off; reconnect after 30s; if controller still abnormal contact service.
1. Turn off; reconnect after 30s. 2. Check stepper motor, transmission, gears for stuck. Restore then restart. 3. Check encoder or motor for damage; replace. 4. Contact service.

troubleshooting.cause: Stepper motor zero position may have drifted
troubleshooting.solution: Enter P81 (stepper zero correction): set stitch gauge to 5mm, run at 4000rpm with A4 paper, adjust P81 until needle completes exactly 10 stitches. Then adjust P82/P83 for forward/reverse stitch compensation at 200rpm.

troubleshooting.issue: Stitch gauge too small or large
troubleshooting.solution: Enter P82 for forward stitch gauge compensation (positive=enlarge, negative=shrink). Enter P83 for reverse stitch gauge compensation. Run at 200rpm with A4 paper. Adjust until 11 stitches match target length.

troubleshooting.issue: Thread tail too long or short after trim
troubleshooting.cause: P47 (trim reverse pull angle) or P49 (trim speed) may need adjustment
troubleshooting.solution: Adjust P47 (trim reverse pull 200-360 degrees — achieves thread rewind function) or P49 (trim speed 100-750).
